title: HB1933 (2017-2018 Regular): Concerning the transfer of firearms at nonprofit fund-raising activities.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1933.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Change is new (4)(g); old (g) becomes (h). Strikes only the word 'or' after (f).

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (1) All firearm sales or transfers, in whole or part in this state including without limitation a sale or transfer where either the purchaser or seller or transferee or transferor is in Washington, shall be subject to background checks unless specifically exempted by state or federal law.
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (4) This section does not apply to:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (g) A transfer of possession of a firearm between individuals while conducting nonprofit fund-raising activities including, but not limited to, auctions, raffles, and contests; or
